issue.title: Verify just install-all Mac paths on the M1: signing preflight, SwiftPM live line, completion banner
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-i0.7 (docs-acceptance phase of epic bob-cli-i0, note #2), plan follow-up (a).

Epic bob-cli-i0 added a live status line, What's-new digest, TTY signing-check preflight,
SwiftPM phase parser, completion bell, and macOS Notification Center banner to
`just install-all` (scripts/install_all, scripts/lib/install_ui/). All acceptance ran on Linux
(athena); the macOS-only branches were exercised only through a fake `uname` in
scripts/lib/install_ui/tests/test_install_all.py.

Verify on the Mac with a real terminal:
- `just signing-check` preflight runs before the Mac Capture install with the keychain
  unlock offer on the terminal; a dim `signing  <identity>` row prints; 77/78 remedies still show.
- The SwiftPM live line moves through app → helper → install ("building Bob Mac Capture app",
  "signing and installing Bob Mac Capture"), unknown notices (Accessibility, ad-hoc,
  "choose Always Allow") still pass through above the line, and exit 72 stays a warning.
- `runs.jsonl` rows for bob-mac-capture have sensible per-phase seconds.
- The completion banner (`ALL INSTALLED · …`, subtitle `bob install-all`) posts after runs ≥ 120 s,
  the bell rings after ≥ 60 s, and neither fires under BOB_INSTALL_NOTIFY=0 or after Ctrl-C.
- The Obsidian restart flow still works after a plugin change.
Capture a real Mac PTY transcript (`script`) and attach it; file bugs for any deviation.

task_type_fields.proposal: Run and transcript a real just install-all on the Mac to confirm the epic's macOS-only paths (signing-check preflight, SwiftPM live line, bell and completion banner, Obsidian restart), filing bugs for deviations.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The epic's agents ran on Linux (athena) and cannot drive macOS signing, Notification Center, or a real SwiftPM build; this needs the Mac host.

issue.creation_reason: Epic bob-cli-i0 shipped macOS-only install-all behavior that could only be tested through a fake uname on Linux; bob-cli-i0.7 proposed a real Mac acceptance run.
